actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Select Worker A for inspect-first execution
actions.expected: Worker A is configured to leave its durable result unreviewed.

actions.label: Preview Worker A plan
actions.expected: The deterministic Worker plan is reviewed before any permit is created.

actions.label: Permit and start Worker A
actions.expected: Only the reviewed deterministic Worker plan receives its one-use permit.

actions.label: Wait for Worker A durable job
actions.expected: Job Center displays the durable plan execution created through preview and permit.

actions.label: Return to the Build workspace
actions.expected: The Inspector refreshes Worker A's completed durable version.

actions.label: Inspect Worker A output
actions.expected: Worker A's exact output and provenance are visible before approval.

actions.label: Open Worker A provenance
actions.expected: Provider, job, and generated output lineage are inspectable before approval.

actions.label: Capture Worker A unreviewed output
actions.expected: The inspect-first result is durable, unreviewed, and visibly tied to the deterministic local simulation.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: Approve Worker A output
actions.expected: The durable output becomes eligible for the next latest-approved lane.

actions.label: Select Worker B and the Image branch
actions.expected: Worker B retains its separately authored instruction and auto-apply policy.

actions.label: Preview approved Worker B image branch
actions.expected: The branch resolves only Worker A's approved result and the fake-local Image Generator before permit.

actions.label: Permit and start Worker B with Image Generator
actions.expected: The previewed Worker B branch is explicitly permitted and started without a real provider or image call.

actions.label: Wait for Worker B and Image Generator durable job
actions.expected: Job Center displays the durable plan execution created through preview and permit.

actions.label: Return to Build for transformed lineage
actions.expected: The completed branch output is inspected in the ordinary canvas workspace.

actions.label: Inspect Worker B transformed output
actions.expected: Worker B's auto-applied durable output preserves its selected approved input lineage.

actions.label: Open Worker B transformed provenance
actions.expected: The output identifies its selected input version instead of changing Worker B's authored instruction.

actions.label: Inspect Image Generator output lineage
actions.expected: The generated image has the Worker B approved version as its selected input.

actions.label: Open Image Generator provenance
actions.expected: The image output preserves the transformed Worker lineage through the latest-approved lane.

actions.label: Capture approved transformed lineage
actions.expected: Worker B auto-applies its valid output, Image Generator consumes that approved version, and Worker B's authored instruction remains unchanged.
actions.actual: Captured after the documented preceding action.

actions.label: T14 practical slice
actions.expected: A blank-authored review-gated Worker chain can safely progress into a deterministic image branch.
actions.actual: Worker A produced an unreviewed durable version that was explicitly approved; Worker B then auto-applied a transformed version consumed by Image Generator through latest-approved lanes while retaining its own instruction.
